mapper.sql: id, task_id, step_code, step_order, status, retry_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_media_process_step(task_id, step_code, step_order, status, retry_count) values(#{taskId}, #{stepCode}, #{stepOrder}, #{status}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: select current_step.* from ai_media_process_step current_step where current_step.task_id = #{taskId} and current_step.status = 'PENDING' and not exists ( select 1 from ai_media_process_step previous_step where previous_step.task_id = current_step.task_id and previous_step.step_order < current_step.step_order and previous_step.status != 'SUCCESS' ) order by current_step.step_order asc limit 1
select from ai_media_process_step where task_id = #{taskId} order by step_order asc
select from ai_media_process_step where step_code = 'ASR_QUERY' and status = 'WAITING' and updated_at <= #{updatedBefore} order by updated_at asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_media_process_step set status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = null, started_at = now(), finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'SUCCESS', error_message = null, finished_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'WAITING', error_message = null, started_at = null, finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'WAITING', error_message = null, finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'WAITING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = null, started_at = now(), finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'WAITING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_media_process_step set status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = null, started_at = null, finished_at = null where id = #{id} and status = 'FAILED'
